Hello everyone!

 I figured It would be good to keep track of these updates, especially so you don't have to ask me later... SO HERE WE ARE! Anyway, today we have a couple of interesting things coming to the server:

  Minor Shop Rework: 
-Changed the way prices were displayed; additional prices, so READ BEFORE YOU BUY 
-Improved internal cost system  
-Added New Shop Item: Speedy Shovel 
-Fast shovel with decent durability (32 Diamond Cost)  
-Changed "Unbreakable Enchant" cost (1 Elytra -> 64 Diamonds)  

---Bug Fixes--- 
-Fixed bug where you couldn't enchant the mace
-Fixed bug that caused Dragon Egg ability to not work  

---Known Issues--- 
-When using "/give" to aquire the Mace it drops a ghost item that you cannot get rid of 
-Mace ability needs a nerf  

Thanks for reading and happy crafting!
